summary: This sermon examines Genesis 22, where God tests Abraham by asking him to sacrifice Isaac. The pastors explain how this difficult passage foreshadows Jesus Christ, with multiple parallels between Isaac and Jesus as beloved sons who carry wood for their sacrifice and follow obediently to their death, while God ultimately provides the sacrifice.
key_points: Abraham's relationship with God gave him understanding of God's character
Genesis 22 contains multiple parallels between Isaac and Jesus (beloved sons, carrying wood, obedient unto death, God providing the sacrifice)
Abraham questioned God at times but remained obedient through faith
Christians must live obediently, not just believe - salvation is the start of the journey, not the end
Knowing God's will requires purposeful steps: reading Scripture, prayer, living godly, and building relationship with God
big_idea: The account of Abraham and Isaac foreshadows the sacrifice of Jesus Christ and teaches that faithful obedience to God is essential even when we cannot see His full plan.
title: Sunday @ Canvas Church
